environment: Local research; not a live production acceptance run
conclusion: Reliable detector avoidance was not demonstrated. Lower scores on one detector failed to transfer to the independent checker. Every specialized BART candidate was rejected for factual or output-quality failures.
score_units: Raw model estimates in [0,1]. Not calibrated authorship probabilities or percentages of AI-written words. Null means not measured.

detectors.precision: BF16 matrix storage with FP32 computation
detectors.inference: Pinned existing production scoring: masked mean pooling, single sigmoid head, 512-token overlapping windows with unique-token coverage weights

specialized_bart.reference_check: One paragraph generated greedily with original FP32 weights also invented content and produced malformed contractions. INT8 output differs, but the failure is present in both. See parity.json.

detector_sanity_findings: Head, sigmoid direction, attention masking and pooling match Desklib's own model card.
All three known-human controls scored below 0.5 on both fixed detectors. This only excludes an obvious always-positive failure on these inputs.
Stored garden score reproduced exactly; its numerical match to another earlier sample was not evidence of a cache bug.
Prior independent FP32 comparison was numerical parity testing, not a model-accuracy benchmark; see docs/selfhost-model-smoke.json.

software_regression_checks.scope: Selected metadata, variable paragraph count, exact cleaned detector inputs, usage aggregation, optional retry failure and invalid scores. Mocked providers; not an efficacy benchmark.

limitations: Three synthetic development documents and three famous historical human excerpts are not representative samples, statistically held-out evaluation or an accuracy benchmark.
Known human excerpts may overlap model training data and differ from contemporary user writing.
Development prompts and styles were chosen while inspecting these examples; no generalization or pass-rate claim is justified.
The two detectors are independent model implementations, not commercial-provider acceptance tests.
API model IDs were recorded; their underlying internal weight revisions are not available.
Single-thread local resource measurements do not establish Render CPU latency or concurrency capacity.
No result establishes human authorship, universal watermark removal or guaranteed undetectability.

integrated_prototype.notice: Local prototype before native Claude structured output; optional second attempt unavailable for team and weekly. Not production acceptance.
